entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return an item. It's an order for some new road cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. I've pulled up your order. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fit issue. I installed my cleats and took them for one ride, but they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't work for my foot shape.
I'm sorry to hear they weren't a comfortable fit. Getting blisters is definitely no fun. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see here that the shoes were delivered just six days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Excellent, that's great news. I appreciate that. Now, since I had to spend time mounting the cleats, and now I have to go through the trouble of boxing them up and shipping them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit order? Just to cover the hassle.

I understand the inconvenience of a product not working out. While I am not able to provide a discount code for a standard return, I can assure you the process is completely free. I am generating a pre-paid shipping label for you right now. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed immediately.
Alright, I suppose that's fair. I had to try. As long as the refund is straightforward, I'm happy. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. The email with your return label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you, Charlie.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
